title: Real-time Distributed Chat System
description: A scalable real-time chat application enabling low-latency communication using a microservices architecture built with Next.js, Socket.IO, Redis, Apache Kafka, and PostgreSQL.
longDescription: The Real-time Distributed Chat System is a high-performance communication platform designed for scalable, low-latency messaging across distributed servers. It leverages Redis for message distribution, Apache Kafka for event processing, and PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM for persistent storage, all orchestrated through a microservices architecture.
features: Asynchronous event processing via Apache Kafka
Persistent storage with PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM
Secure communication with WebSocket authentication and message encryption
High availability through load balancing and server clustering
